notes: SqueekstrToken mints 1,000,000,000 SQUEEKSTR (SQKSTR), with 18 decimals, once to msg.sender in its argument-free constructor. There is no owner, subsequent minting, transfer fee, pause or blocklist. Holders may burn their own tokens and approve allowances through ERC-2612 permit. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
